summary: This clinical trial studies the effects of the drug tirzepatide compared to a placebo in adults who have type 2 diabetes and a buildup of plaque in their heart arteries, known as atherosclerosis. Researchers use special heart scans called coronary computed tomography angiography to measure changes in artery plaque over time. This study is listed as Phase 4 with a target of 120 participants and is sponsored by Matthew J. Budoff.
